blocks.text: Hydrogen ya doosre light (halke) elements mein electrons ki transitions (ek energy level se doosre level par jana) se electromagnetic spectrum ke infrared, visible ya ultraviolet region (hisse) mein spectral lines nikalti hain, kyunke in levels ke darmiyan energy ka farq chhota hota hai.

Heavy (bhari) atoms mein electrons K, L, M, N, O waghaira naam ke concentric shells (ek hi centre wale gol khol) mein maane jate hain: K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb, phir L-shell, waghaira (Fig. 20.3). Andar ke shells ke electrons mazbooti se bandhe (tightly bound) hote hain, inhein apne energy level se hatane ke liye bohat energy chahiye. Excitation (energy le kar oopar jana) ke baad jab atom wapas apni normal state (aam halat) mein aata hai to zyada energy ke photons nikalte hain. Is tarah heavy atoms mein andar ke shells ke electrons ki transitions se high energy photons, yani X-rays, nikalti hain. In X-rays ki khaas (specific) wavelengths ya frequencies hoti hain, is liye inhein characteristic X-rays kehte hain. Characteristic X-rays ke spectra ki study ne atomic structure (atom ki banawat) aur periodic table samajhne mein bohat important role ada kiya (Fig. 20.4).

blocks.alt: Nucleus ke gird chaar dashed circles, shells K, L, M aur N. Neeche baen se aane wala high energy electron (Incident) K shell ke electron se takrata hai; K electron oopar nikal jata hai (Ejected electron) aur aane wala electron daen taraf mur jata hai (Scattered electron).
blocks.caption: Figure 20.3: concentric energy shells (ek hi centre wale energy ke khol) (kitab ki Figure 20.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: High energy (tez) electron K-shell ke electron se takrata hai: K wala electron bahar nikal jata hai (ejected) aur aane wala electron mur kar aage chala jata hai (scattered). K-shell ki khali jagah L ya M shell ka electron bharta hai aur Kα ya Kβ X-ray nikalti hai (equations 20.2 aur 20.3).

blocks.alt: Electromagnetic spectrum ek rangeen patti ki shakal mein, jis par wave ki wavelength daen taraf chhoti hoti jati hai; baen se: radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays aur gamma-rays, saath radio, microwave oven, remote, bulb, Sun (sooraj) aur radiation ke nishan ki chhoti tasveerein. Scale metre mein: 10^3, 1, 10^-3, 10^-5, 10^-7, 10^-9, 10^-11.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.4: electromagnetic spectrum (kitab ki Figure 20.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tarah scale ke nishan 10³, 1, 10⁻³, 10⁻⁵, 10⁻⁷, 10⁻⁹ aur 10⁻¹¹ m barabar faasle par hain, halanke pehle do qadam teen teen powers of ten ke hain aur baqi do do ke; is liye yeh sirf schematic (andaze ka khaaka) hai. Daen taraf wavelength chhoti aur photon ki energy zyada hai; X-rays ultraviolet ke baad aur gamma rays se pehle aati hain.
X-rays ki production (X-rays kaise banti hain)

Fig. 20.5 X-rays banane ka arrangement (intizam) dikhati hai. Is mein high vacuum (andar se hawa bilkul nikali hui) tube hoti hai jise X-ray tube kehte hain. Filament F cathode C ko garam karta hai to cathode electrons chhorta hai. Yeh electrons anode (target) T ki taraf accelerate (tez) kiye jate hain. Agar C aur T ke darmiyan potential difference V ho to target se takrate waqt electron ki maximum kinetic energy (K.E.)ₘₐₓ yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Andar se khali (evacuated) shishe ki tube. Baen taraf cathode C mein coiled (pech-dar) filament (Filament); dotted lines wali electron beams tube ke paar dhalwan wale tungsten target (Tungsten anode) tak jati hain, jo daen taraf cooling channels wale block mein laga hai. Wavy (lehriya) X-rays target ki surface se neeche tube se bahar nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.5: X-rays banane ka arrangement (intizam) (kitab ki Figure 20.5 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filament garam ho kar cathode C se electrons nikalte hain. C aur T ke darmiyan V volt se accelerate ho kar yeh electrons (dotted lines) tungsten anode se takrate hain aur X-rays nikalti hain. Anode bohat garam ho jata hai, is liye cooling channels mein coolant (thanda karne wala liquid) chalta hai.

Farz karein Ve energy wale yeh tez electrons tungsten ya kisi aur heavy element ke target se takrate hain. Collision (takkar) mein sab se andar ke shells (K ya L) ke electrons bahar nikal sakte hain. Agar K-shell ka ek electron nikal jaye to wahan vacancy ya hole (khali jagah) ban jati hai. L-shell ka electron jump kar ke is hole ko bharta hai aur energy hf ka photon chhorta hai, jise Kα X-ray kehte hain:
Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke M-shell ka electron K-shell ka hole bhare. Tab nikalne wale photons Kβ X-rays kehlate hain, aur isi tarah aage bhi:

Andar ke shells ki aisi transitions (inner shell transitions) mein nikalne wale photons characteristic X-rays kehlate hain, kyunke in ki energy target ke material par depend karti hai: har element ki apni khaas lines hoti hain.

L aur M shells mein banne wale holes oopar ke levels ke electrons bharte hain, jis se aur X-rays nikalti hain. Characteristic X-rays continuous spectrum ke oopar alag alag discrete lines (tez chotiyan) ki shakal mein nazar aati hain (Fig. 20.6).

blocks.alt: Intensity aur wavelength (nm) ka graph, nishan 0, 0.04, 0.08 aur 0.12. Curve 0.04 nm par lambda-min tak zero rehta hai, phir uth kar ek shoulder (kandha) banata hai, 0.057 aur 0.063 nm ke qareeb do tez peaks (chotiyan) dikhata hai, aur lambi wavelength par ahista ahista girta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.6: wavelength ke saath X-rays ki intensity (kitab ki Figure 20.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing; kitab mein caption ka text nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Continuous hissa bremsstrahlung hai jo λₘᵢₙ se shuru hota hai. Do tez peaks characteristic lines hain: chhoti wavelength wali (baen) Kβ aur oonchi (daen) Kα.
Continuous X-ray spectrum

Continuous spectrum bremsstrahlung, yani braking radiation (brake lagne, yani achanak rukne se nikalne wali radiation), ki wajah se hai. Tez electrons target se takra kar achanak slow (dheeme) ho jate hain. Hum jante hain ke accelerate hota hua charge (jis ki velocity badal rahi ho) electromagnetic radiation chhorta hai. Is liye target mein tezi se decelerate (dheema) hote electrons radiation chhorte hain. Deceleration itna zyada hai ke radiation ki wavelength chhoti hoti hai, aur bremsstrahlung X-ray region mein hoti hai. Agar koi electron pehli hi collision mein apni saari kinetic energy kho de to woh saari energy ek X-ray photon ban jati hai jis ki energy hfₘₐₓ hai:

Fig. 20.6 ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ isi frequency fₘₐₓ ke mutabiq hai (Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ). Baqi electrons pehli collision mein saari energy nahi khote; rukne se pehle kai collisions karte hain. Is se kam energy, yani lambi wavelength, ke X-ray photons bante hain. Yun electrons ke decelerate hone se continuous spectrum banta hai.

blocks.prompt: 50 kV par chalne wali X-ray tube se nikalne wali X-rays ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ nikalein.

blocks.text: X-ray imaging

Body se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se interaction kar ke energy khoti hain; is process ko attenuation (kamzor hona) kehte hain. X-rays atoms ko ionize kar sakti hain, yani electrons bahar nikal deti hain, aur isi tarah energy transfer (muntaqil) hoti hai. Material se guzarte hue X-ray beam ki intensity ahista ahista kam hoti hai, aur yeh kami exponential pattern (har barabar motai par barabar hissa kam) mein hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula I = I₀ xe^(−μx) chhapti hai, jis mein exponential ke saath ek extra x (thickness, motai) multiply (zarb) hai. Sahi formula I = I₀e^(−μx) hai: thickness x sirf power (exponent) mein aati hai.
Yahan:

items: I = material se guzarne ke baad intensity
x = material ki thickness (motai), metres mein
μ = attenuation coefficient (material aur X-ray ki energy par depend karta hai)

blocks.alt: Baen: thickness x ke saath intensity I = Io e^(-mu x) ke do curves; soft tissue (chhota mu) ahista aur haddi (bara mu) tezi se girti hai. Daen: oopar se X-rays tissue aur us ke andar haddi se guzarti hain; neeche film par haddi ki jagah safaid (bright) saya aur baqi film kaali hai.
blocks.caption: X-ray imaging mein attenuation aur contrast (hamari drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Haddi ka μ soft tissue se bohat zyada hai, is liye haddi mein se kam X-rays guzarti hain. Film par jahan kam X-rays pohanchti hain woh hissa safaid (bright) rehta hai. Isi farq se haddi aur tissue alag nazar aate hain, yani contrast banta hai.

Real-time X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy, yani chalti hui X-ray video) mein image intensifiers istemal hote hain. Yeh image ko bright kar ke dekhna aasan banate hain aur radiation exposure (mareez par radiation) kam karte hain. X-ray image mein contrast ka matlab hai ke mukhtalif tissues kitni clearly (saaf) alag pehchane ja sakte hain; contrast X-rays ki energy par depend karta hai. Hard X-rays (zyada energy) haddiyon ki image ke liye, aur soft X-rays (kam energy) breast jaise soft tissues ke liye behtar hain. Contrast media khaas substances (cheezein) hain jaise iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jo X-rays ko khoob absorb karti hain. Inhein injection se diya jata hai ya nigla jata hai taa ke body ke khaas hisse highlight (numayan) hon. Zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray absorption barha kar un tissues ko saaf dikhati hain.
Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: Heavy atoms mein inner shells ki transitions characteristic X-rays deti hain (Kα: E_L − E_K; Kβ: E_M − E_K).
X-ray tube: V se accelerate hue electrons, (K.E.)ₘₐₓ = Ve, tungsten target se takrate hain.
Continuous spectrum: bremsstrahlung; sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ jahan Ve = hfₘₐₓ.
Attenuation: I = I₀e^(−μx); contrast media (iodine, barium) contrast barhate hain.
